qa_pair.question: Convert both fixture recordings, test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr (recording A) and test/fixtures/test.axtr (recording B), to markdown. How many user actions do the two recordings contain in total? Answer with the number.
Using recordings A (test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr) and B (test/fixtures/test.axtr): which form (AOT name) is visited in recording B but not in recording A? Answer with the form's AOT name.

Of the two fixture recordings test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr and test/fixtures/test.axtr, exactly one contains a navigation step that opens a menu item. Which file is it, and which menu item does the step open? Answer as filename,menu-item with no spaces.

The BPM package inside each fixture recording lists the tables behind the visited form ("Data Sources"). How many more tables does test/fixtures/test.axtr list than test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr? Answer with the number.

One of the two fixture recordings (test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr, test/fixtures/test.axtr) has a step acting on a null control. Name that file, and give the AOT control name (the bracketed identifier) of the hyperlink step in the OTHER recording. Answer as filename,control with no spaces.

Across both fixture recordings (test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr and test/fixtures/test.axtr), which distinct command action types occur? Answer with the type names sorted alphabetically, comma-separated, no spaces.

How many distinct privileges (AOT names) appear in the BPM security-role tables of the two fixture recordings test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr and test/fixtures/test.axtr combined? Answer with the number.

In test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr, which privilege (AOT name) appears with Full control in the BPM security-role table, and how many Full-control rows does the table of test/fixtures/test.axtr contain? Answer as privilege,count with no spaces.

Do the two fixture recordings test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr and test/fixtures/test.axtr share the same recording name? Do they share the same canonical ID? Answer as name,id where each is True or False, no spaces.

Exactly one step across the two fixture recordings (test/fixtures/taskrec-sample.axtr, test/fixtures/test.axtr) carries a list/grid context. Which file, which step number, and which grid? Answer as filename,step,grid with no spaces.
